test_results.observation: Reconciliation used Workspace-scoped ownership reads, preserved retained and too-young objects, and represented inconsistent records as report-only corrective work.

Operational metrics read authoritative lifecycle state, kept cleanup counters per durable attempt/replay, and produced positive completed orphan-reconciliation counts without unsafe labels.
Every required versioned alert class was required by configuration; configured threshold, sustain and recovery behavior emitted typed low-cardinality alerts only.
Crash after external delete was reconciled through head without another delete, while indeterminate head state failed safe and preserved independent lifecycle retry behavior.

Terminal Job/Attempt and lifecycle work behaved as a bidirectional atomic outcome: faulted terminalization committed neither projection, success created exactly one work item and replay did not duplicate it.
A stale worker after lease handoff was fenced before delete and completion; the valid successor claimed the work with no simultaneous valid ownership.
A prepared delete generation could not cause a destructive effect after attachment/retention changed authoritative ownership; an unchanged valid generation completed successfully.

Controlled RandomSource requests used exactly the 5-second, 30-second and 2-minute bounds once per scheduling decision; returned samples were persisted exactly, the fourth failure was terminal and no fifth attempt existed.
